referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset describes the transmission of the electricity mix used for the operation of storage pumps in Germany in winter 2018 and includes the high voltage network infrastructure (including long-distance transport), transmission losses and air pollutant emissions. Not included are electricity losses due to long-distance transport since they are assumed to be contained in the total electricity losses of the country network.
